Application is allowed.

Main case

Present petition has been filed under Section 482 of BNSS for grant of anticipatory bail to the petitioner in criminal complaint bearing No.COMA-497 dated 09.08.2021, under Section42(5)

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner has placed on record the relevant zimini orders of the trial Court showing that in compliance of order dated 29.04.2025 passed by this Court, the petitioner is appearing before the trial Court.

In view of the above, the instant petition is allowed and the relief, as extended to the petitioner by this Court vide order dated 29.04.2025, is hereby made absolute along with direction to the petitioner to appear before the trial Court on each and every date of hearing.
Pending application(s), if any, shall also stand disposed of.
(SUKHVINDER KAUR) JUDGE 31.10.2025.
